jobs.title: Full-Time LSAT Tutor
jobs.description: About Inspira Education Inspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US. We started with a simple mission to democratize access to high-quality coaching so that every student in the world has an equal opportunity to access the best opportunities. As the world’s leading network of top admissions coaches in medical, legal, business, and college studies, we’re building software and services in one place—disrupting long-entrenched application processes with products and experiences that strive to provide an equal platform for candidates from diverse backgrounds worldwide. As one of the fastest-growing edtech firms in the world, we are backed by some of the leading venture capital firms and investors in the world, including Zeev Ventures, Quiet Capital, Craft Ventures and Jeff Fluhr (Founder of Stubhub). The Role We are looking for an experienced full-time LSAT Tutor to provide one-on-one LSAT preparation to students. You will teach all sections of the LSAT, develop individualized study plans, and track student progress throughout their preparation. This is a full-time, remote role that can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada. The 40-hour workweek includes 5–10 hours of preparation time, with tutoring scheduled around student availability, including weekday afternoons, evenings, and weekends. Responsibilities Tutor students one-on-one across all sections of the LSAT Develop and adapt LSAT study plans based on each student's needs and performance Track and analyze student progress Create and maintain project trackers to monitor LSAT preparation progress Keep students' families up to date on academic progress and milestones Participate in additional opportunities as they arise, such as leading webinars or training other tutors Qualifications Bachelor's degree or higher Previously taken the Law School Admission Test (LSAT); official score report required LSAT score in the 99th percentile 2+ years of LSAT tutoring or LSAT test-pre

jobs.title: Lead Instructor, EMEA
jobs.description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. About TRM TRM Labs is on a mission to build a safer world by fighting crime and protecting the people who investigate it. We started as a blockchain intelligence company, helping law enforcement, government agencies, financial institutions, and businesses detect, investigate, and disrupt crypto-enabled crime. Today our platform reaches well beyond the blockchain: we fuse on-chain data with cyber and open-source intelligence (OSINT) so investigators can move from a single crypto address to the full story behind a criminal network. Our blockchain intelligence and AI intelligence platforms turn fragmented signals into fast, defensible investigative leads for the teams protecting public safety and national security every day. TRM Academy delivers training and certification for the global community of investigators, analysts, and compliance professionals who detect and prevent fraud and financial crime involving cryptocurrencies. Learners get live and virtual courses, practical exercises, and a community of the world's experts in blockchain, crypto compliance, and financial crime investigations. About the Role As the Lead Instructor, EMEA , you will own the design and delivery of TRM Academy training across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, with blockchain intelligence and crypto investigations at the core of what you teach. You will turn complex on-chain concepts into practical, mission-ready skills for law enforcement, national security, and government audiences, and you will be equally comfortable teaching crypto businesses, exchanges, and financial institutions. jobs.title: Guru Matematika SMP / SMA
jobs.description: Bimbel One adalah perusahaan yang bergerak di bidang pendidikan untuk membantu siswa-siswi mencapai hasil yang terbaik. Sejak berdiri, Bimbel One memiliki budaya The Champion Tradition. Banyak siswa yang setelah bergabung dengan Bimbel One mengalami perubahan positif dan menjadi yang terbaik di sekolah-sekolah unggulan. Dalam rangka untuk membantu lebih banyak siswa, Bimbel One membutuhkan individu-individu berkualitas, yang memiliki passion pada dunia pendidikan, untuk bergabung menjadi Guru Matematika SMP / SMA. Job description : - Membuat persiapan pembelajaran -Melakukan kegiatan belajar mengajar Matematika SMP / SMA -Membuat penilaian dan laporan hasil belajar murid -Membina hubungan yang baik dengan murid, rekan kerja, dan orang tua murid -Bersedia ditempatkan di Muara Karang (Jakarta Utara) / Green Ville (Jakarta Barat) / Gading Serpong (Tangerang) Kualifikasi : - Memiliki passion di bidang pendidikan - Senang dan tekun belajar - Dapat mengajar kurikulum internasional - Sabar dan suka membimbing - Komunikatif dan ramah - Percaya diri dan berkepribadian menyenangkan - Berinisiatif dan bertanggung jawab - Pendidikan minimal S1 Matematika / Fisika / Kimia / Teknik, diutamakan FKIP - Dapat bekerja full time
